React directives (not Next.js-specific):
- `'use client'`: marks a Client Component; required for React hooks, event handlers, and browser APIs.
- `'use server'`: marks a Server Action, passable to Client Components; may be inline in a Server Component.
- `'use cache'`: marks a function/component for caching (Next.js Cache Components); requires `cacheComponents: true` in `next.config.ts`. For cache profiles, `cacheLife()`, `cacheTag()`, and `updateTag()`, see the `next-cache-components` skill.

References: https://react.dev/reference/rsc/use-client ; https://react.dev/reference/rsc/use-server ; https://nextjs.org/docs/app/api-reference/directives/use-cache
